inbox: Range selects back to the anchor, then every row moves to Someday
inbox: add a tag; a tag every selected row has writes nothing; exit
inbox: Remove tag offers only the tags the selection carries
inbox: delete asks first, then Undo restores
inbox: Bulk organize to Waiting with a person, a project, dates, contexts and tags
inbox: Bulk organize an area and No project; Keep resets the choices
inbox: Bulk organize with nothing chosen writes nothing
reference: the bar, Remove tag, move to Next, then delete and Undo
reference: with archived projects shown, a read-only row is not selectable and Range skips it
done: the bar offers Archived; move to Archived, remove and add a tag, then delete and Undo
waiting: no Remove tag; add a tag, then Range and move to Next
someday: Move to section, add a tag, delete and Undo, then Range and move to Next
project: every status, Bulk organize and Remove tag; organize, tags, move, delete and Undo
